proofs.P08-sdk-http-component: The @modelcontextprotocol/sdk WebStandard Streamable HTTP client/server complete initialization, tool discovery, and action invocation through the module HTTP contribution. proofs.P08-bearer-stdio-client: The stdio API client sends owner bearer authentication to the namespaced project action/proposal API, validates project discovery responses, binds a selected owner project, forwards SDK cancellation to fetch, and submits proposal IDs without caller-controlled source. These are API-client tests; a spawned stdio process against a running composed API is not yet verified.
proofs.P08-mutation-boundary: Persistent MCP changes route through canonical proposal actions. create_scene invokes story.entities.create, update_entity invokes story.entities.update, lint_manuscript fix invokes diagnostics.proposeLintFix, and submit_change_set passes the complete validated source NarrativeChangeSet v1 payload to story.changes.propose. The MCP surface exposes no author approval, apply, checkpoint, reconciliation, or publication operation. ChangeSet get/list reconstruct source IDs, operation results, approval IDs, and checkpointed revisions from persisted Story evidence and Core proposal status; pending checkpoints do not synthesize a result, and partial results require checkpoint receipts.
proofs.P08-source-tools-registered: The SDK test confirms all 27 source tool names remain registered, alongside project/action discovery and status/history/observation tools. Source Story and Diagnostics tools invoke their declared host actions when available; absent producers return typed MODULE_UNAVAILABLE or ACTION_UNAVAILABLE results. Hybrid semantic search and full speaker-composed get_diagnostics fail closed until their exact actions are available.
proofs.P08-context-manifest-parity: The context-manifest tests verify source-compatible FNV-1a selection identity, Unicode character bounds and title truncation, the 50,000-character manuscript cap, 5,000-character selection limit, source revisions, manifest-only omission, and provenance fields.
proofs.P08-proposal-only-mutations: Source HTTP create_scene and lint-fix direct-write paths and source stdio lint persistence are replaced by proposal actions. No MCP handler writes project files or commits directly.
